preview.note4k: 4K uses VP9, which some players can't play.
preview.title: Video preview
preview.slow: Still looking ({{n}} s). Playlists and channels with many videos take longer.

empty.title: Paste a URL to start downloading
empty.body: Copy the URL of a YouTube video or playlist, then press Ctrl+V.

invalidUrl.title: This isn't a valid URL
invalidUrl.hint: Check that the URL is complete and starts with https://.

unsupportedSite.title: This site isn't supported
unsupportedSite.hint: Only YouTube videos and playlists are supported for now.

notFound.title: Video not found
notFound.hint: It may have been removed. Check that the URL is correct.

private.title: This video is private
private.hint: Only people the uploader allows can see it, so it can't be downloaded.

ageRestricted.title: This video is age-restricted
ageRestricted.hint: Videos like this aren't supported yet, so it can't be downloaded.

membersOnly.title: This video is for members only
membersOnly.hint: Videos like this aren't supported yet, so it can't be downloaded.

geoBlocked.title: This video isn't available in your region
geoBlocked.hint: The uploader restricted where it can be watched, so it can't be downloaded.

playlistNotFound.title: Playlist not found
playlistNotFound.hint: It may be private or deleted. Check the URL.

liveNotSupported.title: Live streams aren't supported
liveNotSupported.hint: Try again after the stream ends and the video is published.

playlistUrl.title: This is a playlist URL
playlistUrl.hint: Paste it again and wait for the list, then pick what to download.

network.title: Can't connect
network.hint: Check your internet connection, then retry.

unknown.title: Something unexpected went wrong
unknown.hint: You can retry. The log file has details.

close.body: Items in progress or waiting will stop. The queue isn't kept, so you'll need to add them again. Finished files stay where they are.

crash.title: Something went wrong on this screen
crash.body: Downloads aren't affected and keep running. Reload the screen to get back to your queue.

toast.openedFolder: Couldn't find the file, so its folder was opened instead.
toast.notFound: Couldn't find the file or its folder. It may have been moved or deleted.
toast.notUrl: The clipboard doesn't contain a URL.

live.addedMany_one: Added {{count, number}} item to the queue
live.addedMany_other: Added {{count, number}} items to the queue

cancelAll.title_one: {{count, number}} item hasn't finished. Cancel it?
cancelAll.title_other: {{count, number}} items haven't finished. Cancel them all?
cancelAll.body: Items in progress or waiting will stop. Finished files stay where they are. Cancelled items have to be added again one by one.
